product.description: This Single‑Monitor Gas‑Spring Desk Mount provides fully adjustable mounting for smaller monitors with screen sizes up to 27". It is a smaller and lower‑priced version of the best‑selling Monoprice™ gas spring monitor mounts. The adjustable, articulating monitor arm allows for the most comfortable positioning of your LCD display to help reduce eye, neck, and shoulder strain. Smooth Full‑Range MotionEasy Setup FlexibilitySupports Most 27" MonitorsSmooth Full‑Range Motion: Adjustments are easy to make thanks to the counterbalanced gas‑spring arm. Effortlessly raise, lower, pull, push, and adjust your monitor with gas‑spring assistance for the perfect working position and most comfortable viewing angle.Easy Setup Flexibility: Organize your workspace and clear desk space by raising your monitor off the desk surface. Setup is quick and easy using the included edge clamp or grommet mount.Supports Most 27" Monitors: The monitor arm supports up to 14.3 lbs. of weight and works best with screens up to 27"*.
